title: A Geometric Interpretation of Heavy-Quark Transitions and the Emergent SU(2) Structure
summary: We propose a geometric interpretation of heavy-light mesons in which their infrared dressing is described through adiabatic Berry holonomies on the functional space of gauge configurations. Within this framework the Berry curvature associated with the infrared cloud carries a quantized functional flux, providing a simple and structural origin for the exponential form of the Isgur-Wise function in single-recoil transitions. Sequential processes such as $B \rightarrow D^{**} \rightarrow D$ probe two independent recoil directions and explore a two-dimensional region of the adiabatic manifold.…
